publications.explanation:
In the interactive model intended here, a sender conveys a message and the receiver responds with feedback. Both participants help establish understanding, so the process is two-way and mutual. That makes D, both (b) and (c), the intended answer. The distinction is feedback: a one-way broadcast does not include a return response. Communication models can describe one-way transmission too, so do not treat this answer as a rule that every form of communication must be two-way.

Reference: [CBSE, Front Office Operations XI, Communication Models](https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Curriculum21/publication/srsec/FRONT_OFFICE_OPERATIONS_revised-NEW_XI.pdf).
